  "messageType" => "messageType",

    "text" => "text",

    ]

    ]

      ]

sections.title: API overview
sections.content:
This endpoint enables you to take your customers on a seamless messaging journey, foster a deeper connection with your brand, and gain valuable customer insights along the way. Whether you're sending to one recipient or multiple, you can do it all in a single request.

The documentation in this section contains the core reference information you will need to send an outbound message via our API, including required headers, code examples & error codes.

Before you start using this endpoint, please check you have your Account, API Key and Base URL set up and have familiarised yourself with our implementation prerequisites in our Introduction documentation.

sections.title: Headers
sections.content:
These parameters are mandatory to be provided in the header of your request. If not provided, or incorrect, your request will fail.

HeaderTypeDescription
Content-TypeStringapplication/json
X-Api-KeyStringAPI Key value for authorization

Example request header:
POST https://api.spryng.nl/v2/messages
-H 'Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'
-H 'Content-Type: application/json'

sections.title: Request body
sections.content:
You can use the cURL sample provided on the right hand side of this page to directly copy/paste into your chosen integration tool, using the below properties to modify your request as required for your business needs.

Required, or conditional, request body parameters

If a required parameter is not provided, or incorrect, the request will fail. If a parameter is conditional, it is only required for certain channels or is dependant on the desired format of the message.

ParameterTypeRequired or ConditionalDescription
accountReferenceStringRequiredYour Spryng account reference - e.g. SPNL0000000
channelStringRequiredThe channel to be used for the message. Allowed options SMS
bodyJSON objectRequiredThe content of the message being sent. It can contain 2 possible strings: either "text" or "templateId" provided in GUID format
body.textStringConditionalRequired if not using "templateId".Text in the message body should be provided as a String. Variables can be provided using square brackets such as “variablename1” and “example2”. Only one of “text” or “templateId” should be provided within a request. If you would like to include a shortened URL within your message body embed shorten: http://example.com into your message "text" string. Note: this feature is not available during Trial
body.templateIdGUIDConditionalThe value of the template you wish to use in your message
fromStringConditionalRequired if no default senderId has beeen set. This is the originator to be used. This can be alphanumeric aka senderId or numeric. If numeric it must be a VMN or Shortcode that you have purchased. If alphanumeric then you may need to register the senderId in advance. You can set a default senderId in your Spryng portal account
recipientsJSON arrayConditionalUse recipients if you wish to send to a numbers which is not registered as a contact. Can contain an array of recipient objects between 1 and 50000. Either "recipients" or "addressbook" must be provided
addressBookJSON objectConditionalRequired if not using "recipients". Use addressBook if you wish to send to existing contacts. If using addressBook addressBook.contacts & addressBook.contacts.id will be required. A max of 50000 contacts can be sent in a single request
addressBook.contactsJSON arrayConditionalRequired when using "addressBook". Can contain an array of contacts
addressBook.contacts.idGUIDConditionalRequired when using "addressBook". The contactId of the contacts you wish to send your message to. A max limit of 10000 contactIds can be provided per request


Optional request body parameters

These parameters are not mandatory within the request body, they are designed to provide you further capability to customise or filter your requests.

ParameterTypeDescription
nameStringOptional friendly name for the request. Will be present message history export and can make some data analysis or grouping easier
characterSetStringAllowed character sets are: Auto | GSM | Unicode. GSM uses a smaller character set which allows characters per message part to around 140. Unicode allows using of a large set of special characters and unicode emojis but reduces characters per message part to around 70. Auto will detect if unicode characters are used and default to GSM if not. If omitted
validityTimestampRetry period of the message. If provided the validity must be more than 1 minute and less than 72 hours in the future. Default = 72 hours. e.g. 2025-07-19T09:07:12.190Z
messageTypeStringUsed to help reporting on certain message types. Enum e.g. MarketingAndResearch | NotificationsAndReminders | AuthenticationAndSecurity | PaymentsAndCollections | InternalOperations | CustomerSupport |Conversational
metaDataJSON objectCan contain "key": "value" pairs. These are saved with the message and will be returned when exporting the message history. This can make some data analysis easier


In order to shorten a URL within a message, embed [shorten: http://example/longURL.com] into the request "body.text" property. The platform will then automatically convert your long URL into a shortened URL in format uk.endx.io/abcd123. These are unique per recipient.

Request body examples below

Sending to SMS using "recipients" and "text" body

{
    "accountReference" : "SPNL0000000",
    "name": "name",
    "characterSet": "GSM",
    "channel": "SMS",
    "from": "71460491",
    "validity": "2025-07-19T09:07:12.190Z",
    "messageType": "MarketingAndResearch",
    "body": {
        "text": "example",
    },
    "recipients": [
        {
            "msisdn": "+447711000032",
            "variables": {
            },
            "metaData": {
            }
        }
    ],
    "metaData": {
        "zsuvhhn": "niqloaf",
        "xljgmvj": "akwenax"
    }
}

Sending to SMS using "recipients" and "text" body with a shortened URL
{
    "accountReference" : "SPNL0000000",
    "name": "name",
    "characterSet": "GSM",
    "channel": "SMS",
    "from": "71460491",
    "validity": "2025-07-19T09:07:12.190Z",
    "messageType": "MarketingAndResearch",
    "body": {
        "text": "message body text which includes a url [shorten:http://example/longurl.com]",
    },
    "recipients": [
        {
            "msisdn": "+447711000032",
            "variables": {
            },
            "metaData": {
            }
        }
    ],
    "metaData": {
        "zsuvhhn": "niqloaf",
        "xljgmvj": "akwenax"
    }
}

Sending to SMS using "addressBook" and a "templateId"
{
    "accountReference" : "SPNL0000000",
    "name": "name",
    "characterSet": "GSM",
    "channel": "SMS",
    "from": "71460491",
    "validity": "2025-07-19T09:07:12.190Z",
    "messageType": "MarketingAndResearch",
    "body": { 
          "templateId": "
    },
"addressBook": {
    "contacts": [
      {
        "id": "c1fa7d5e-46a0-47fc-83da-1f44a99edd92"
      }
    ]
  },
    ],
    "metaData": {
        "zsuvhhn": "niqloaf",
        "xljgmvj": "akwenax"
    }
}

sections.title: Responses
sections.content:
The standard responses for this API are listed below. For a full list of possible REST API status codes, please refer to this guide.

Success
202 Accepted
Indicates that the request has been received but not completed yet.
{
    "data": {
        "requestId": "8dcad127-bb9c-48fe-9827-db2fe57d53fb",
        "messageIds": [
            "0929df71-d1ea-4b02-87b2-9789b332a92e"
        ]
    }
}

Error Codes
400 Bad Request
The server could not understand the request due to incorrect syntax or an incorrect/missing required property. You should not repeat the request without modifications.
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "errorCode": "string",
      "errorMessage": "string"
    }
  ]
}

401 Unauthorized
Indicates that the request has failed due to missing or incorrect authentication information. You can repeat the request with a suitable authorization header.
{
    "errors": [
        {
            "errorCode": "unauthenticatedError",
            "errorMessage": "Request for authenticated route '/v2/messages' was unauthenticated"
        }
    ]
}
